title: 2023 Select Black/Green Die-Cut Prizm RC #63 De'Von Achane Dolphins
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This De'Von Achane Black and Green Die Cut Prizm RC 2023 Select NFL #63 sports trading card is a must-have for any Miami Dolphins fan. Featuring a rookie design, this card is made from high-quality card stock with a thickness of 35 Pt. The card is an original licensed product from Select and is part of the 2023 Select set.

The card is a Die-Cut parallel variety with a unique Black and Green design, making it a standout addition to any collection. This card is not autographed but is still a valuable piece of memorabilia for any NFL fan. As a National Football League (NFL) enthusiast, this card is a great addition to any collection and is sure to impress.
